caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt composed of twenty square panels arranged in a 4 by 5 grid. Each square features an embroidered image framed with colorful fabric borders in shades of blue, red, green, brown, plum, and beige. The inner sections of the squares showcase various individual designs, including birds, flowers, plants, animals (such as a deer, dog, and chicken), and human figures (such as a girl wearing a red hooded cape, reminiscent of Little Red Riding Hood). Floral motifs with pink, red, yellow, purple, and white flowers are prominent throughout the composition. Some squares display stylized leaves, a bird sitting in a tree, and fruit. The fabric appears textured and slightly worn in places, and the stitching is visible, lending detail to the images. The overall background visible between the squares is a neutral, light color.
title: Appliqued Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
